description: Who YOU are on this organization's chart: your seat id, name, and role, who you escalate to, your immediate colleagues (peers under the same manager, names and types only), and the KPIs you are measured on. Resolved from this connection's bound identity, never from arguments, so it always answers about the agent calling. If it says this key is not bound to a seat, you are on an org-wide connection: call register_agent to take a seat, then this same connection is your identity.
name: get_my_seat
